subject: Re: SIG + SOC2 evidence onboarding — procurement kickoff and clarifications
messages:
From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@acadiahealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acadiahealth.com, lauren.meyer@acadiahealth.com
Date: Tue, 24 Apr 2028 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Acadia RFP - SIG / SOC2 kickoff

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the performance numbers and the model isolation options. Procurement asked me to pull together the SIG questionnaire and SOC2 evidence checklist so we can start the formal review. Attached is our master SIG workbook with the questions we've prioritized (section A for production services, section B for private deployments).

Before we start, two quick asks so we can scope:
- Can Redwood provide a control mapping (SIG -> SOC2 control & short evidence pointer) for the next 10 business days?
- We need confirmation on data residency for dedicated pools (are there region locks per customer?).
- Any known redlines in your standard SOW that typically impact timelines?

Lauren (legal) is CC'd — she may have a few contract-specific asks. Let me know if an internal kickoff call next week makes sense.

Cheers,
Sanjay
Sanjay Patel
Senior Procurement Manager
Acadia Health

Attachment: Acadia-SIG-Questions-Filled.xlsx (xlsx, 48 KB)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@acadiahealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Apr 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acadia RFP - SIG / SOC2 kickoff

Sanjay — thanks for the workbook and for prioritizing the questions. Quick responses inline, then proposed next steps.

Inline:
- Control mapping: yes, we can deliver a SIG->SOC2 crosswalk with evidence pointers. We'll produce an initial pass ("Redwood-SIG-Responses-v1.xlsx") within 5 business days and follow with a curated evidence packet within 10 business days.
- Data residency for Dedicated: Dedicated pools can be region-locked at deployment time. We offer US-East and US-West single-region pins today; EU locking is available under Private deployments with an additional network configuration step. I will have Priyom confirm the technical gating items.
- SOW redlines: our common delays are around export controls and a narrow KMS key custody clause. Kimberly, can you flag typical contractual exceptions and an estimated turnaround for legal review?

Proposed next steps:
1) We'll upload Redwood-SIG-Responses-v1 to the SharePoint link and attach the SOC2 summary (public evidence bundle) by end of day Friday (28 Apr).
2) Schedule a 45-minute sync early next week to walk the mapping and the evidence handoff process — suggest Tue 2 May 9:00am PT.
3) Kimberly to review contract points and provide a short list of potential redlines for Acadia's legal.

I'll also include a short evidence manifest to describe where each artifact lives (S3 path vs. sample PDF).

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachment: SOC2-summary-2027.pdf (pdf, 210 KB)

From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@acadiahealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Meyer <lauren.meyer@acadiahealth.com>, procurement@acadiahealth.com
Date: Thu, 26 Apr 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acadia RFP - SIG / SOC2 kickoff

Vivek — that timeline works for us. I'm attaching the prioritized question set with two additional columns: 'risk_impact' and 'requested_deadline' — we've marked 12 items as high (need evidence for our compliance board).

Also: Lauren asked whether you support a limited export-control clause for hosted inference in the EU; she says the contract team will propose language if you can confirm it's a common ask.

I've tentatively accepted the Tue 2 May slot on our side. Please send a Teams invite when you confirm.

Thanks,
Sanjay

Attachment: Acadia-SIG-Questions-Filled.xlsx (updated, xlsx, 52 KB)

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 27 Apr 2028 11:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Acadia RFP - SIG / SOC2 evidence onboarding — internal notes

Vivek / Kimberly — quick internal note after reviewing Sanjay's updated sheet.

1) Evidence scope: The 12 high-risk items map to the following artifacts we can deliver as samples:
   - Access control matrix (redacted) -> sample: access-matrix-2027.csv
   - KMS key proof -> sample: kms-rotation-ops-summary.pdf
   - SOC2 system description excerpt -> sample: soc2-system-desc-2027.pdf

2) Data residency: For Dedicated we can confirm region locking for US-East/US-West. EU-only dedicated is not on the self-serve console today; it will require a Private deployment option (estimate 3-4 weeks for network config + validation).

3) Next steps before the Tue 2 May call:
   - Kimberly: can you prepare a one-page legal note on the KMS custody clause and export-control template language (Lauren will expect draft language to speed redlines).
   - I'll prepare the Redwood-SIG-Responses-v1 crosswalk and flag artifacts that need redaction.

I'll stage the initial artifacts in a read-only S3 bucket and share a signed URL in the SharePoint manifest before EOD Friday.

Priyom
Principal Security Engineer
Redwood Inference
